2026-09-04GAC, FINCustoms TariffUnited States Surtax Order (2026)United States Surtax Order (2026) in order to (1) establishes counter-tariffs on a range of goods, including products such as dairy, appliances, agricultural equipment, pulp and paper, and electronics, that are most impacted by U.S. tariffs which will be set at 15, 25, or 50 per cent, generally matching the corresponding U.S. rate; and (2) extend the application of the existing remission framework to these goods.Registration: SOR/2026-0186 Publication Date: 2026-09-23
subject: United States Surtax Order (2026)
precis: United States Surtax Order (2026) in order to (1) establishes counter-tariffs on a range of goods, including products such as dairy, appliances, agricultural equipment, pulp and paper, and electronics, that are most impacted by U.S. tariffs which will be set at 15, 25, or 50 per cent, generally matching the corresponding U.S. rate; and (2) extend the application of the existing remission framework to these goods.
